source: メガトン第 7 居住甲板 (src/world/megaton.js) の改修用。画像が無いあいだは既存の素材に色を付けて代用している。自分で作った 3x3 の画像を assets/textures/sheets/<id>.webp に置くか、texgen.py generate で生成する
style: Machines and utilities that keep a space-habitat city alive, plus its parks. Flat, evenly lit, front-on or top-down, no shadows, no readable text.

cells.name: mg-valve-panel
cells.prompt: A wall of pipes with valves and round pressure gauges, colour-coded pipes, front-on.

cells.name: mg-breaker
cells.prompt: An open electrical distribution board: rows of circuit breakers and neat cables, front-on.

cells.name: mg-louver
cells.prompt: A metal ventilation louver grille, horizontal slats, front-on.

cells.name: mg-elevator
cells.prompt: Closed stainless steel elevator doors with a floor indicator above and call buttons at the side.

cells.name: mg-district-map
cells.prompt: A residential district map sign: a top-down plan of winding corridors, apartment blocks, a park and a plaza in soft colours, no words.

cells.name: mg-cardboard
cells.prompt: Side of cardboard moving boxes: brown corrugated cardboard with tape strips and fragile icons, front-on.

cells.name: mg-sky
cells.prompt: An artificial sky ceiling seen from below: soft blue sky with thin white clouds, bright and even, seamless.

cells.name: mg-pond
cells.prompt: A small garden pond seen from above: calm green-blue water with orange koi and floating lily pads.

cells.name: mg-park-grass
cells.prompt: Park lawn from directly above: dense fresh green grass with a few clover leaves.
